settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.intro: Quick answers to common questions from global B2B buyers.

settings.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
settings.answer: MOQ varies by product. Contact us with the products and quantities you need, and we will provide the applicable MOQ.

settings.question: Can you provide OEM & ODM services?
settings.answer: Yes. We can support customization of product shape, size, color, material, branding and packaging depending on the project.

settings.question: Can I request private label products?
settings.answer: Yes. Private label options are available for suitable products and order quantities.

settings.question: What are your main silicone product categories?
settings.answer: Our range covers kitchenware, food storage, baby, pet, household, bathroom, beauty, and outdoor & sports products.

settings.question: How can I request a quotation?
settings.answer: Submit the inquiry form above with your products, estimated quantity, target market and customization requirements. Our sales team will follow up with the relevant details.
